Drishyam 3 Box Office: Ajay Devgn Starrer Completes 30 Days in Theatres

Box Office Performance After 30 Days

'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion', starring Ajay Devgn, has completed 30 days in theatres and continues to report box office collections. According to industry data trackers such as Sacnilk, the thriller recorded a rise in collections on its 30th day, Saturday, pulling in Rs 1.60 crore net in India—a 60% increase compared to the previous day's collection of Rs 1 crore.

With these latest figures, the film's total domestic net collection has reached Rs 375.60 crore, while the India gross stands at Rs 449.84 crore. International markets have also contributed to the overall figures, with overseas gross collections reaching Rs 132.55 crore, bringing the worldwide gross total to an estimated Rs 582.39 crore.

Weekly Collection Trends

The film's box office run has seen a gradual decline week-over-week, which is typical for theatrical releases:

  • Week 1: Rs 245.50 crore net
  • Week 2: Rs 87.50 crore net (64.4% decline)
  • Week 3: Rs 28.85 crore net (67% decline)
  • Week 4: Rs 11.15 crore net (61.4% decline)
  • Week 5 (Initial days): Rs 2.60 crore net

Despite the weekly drops, the film's daily ticket sales and occupancy rates indicate continued audience interest during its fifth week.

Occupancy and Screening Details

On its 30th day, the film ran across 3,030 shows in India, selling an estimated 79,067 tickets. Cumulative ticket sales have reached 1,63,11,873 since its release. The Hindi 2D version recorded the following occupancy trends across different time slots:

  • Morning shows: 8.83%
  • Afternoon shows: 17.42%
  • Evening shows: 19.83%
  • Night shows: 20.67%

Comparison With 'Drishyam 2'

Reports indicate that the latest instalment has outperformed its predecessor at the same 30-day milestone. While 'Drishyam 3' has crossed Rs 375.60 crore in domestic net collections, 'Drishyam 2' had earned Rs 218.79 crore in India net collections at the corresponding stage of its theatrical run.

Plot Overview

The narrative follows Vijay Salgaonkar years after the events of the previous films. His life is disrupted when Meera Deshmukh returns seeking revenge rather than standard justice. Additionally, a powerful Crime Branch officer launches a renewed investigation, testing Vijay's alibis and his ability to protect his family.

Verification and Disclaimer

Box office figures are compiled from industry trackers and public sources like Sacnilk. These numbers are approximate and subject to updates as official studio reports and international tallies are finalized.
